content: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniels, badge number 762491. Who am I speaking with today?
Uh, hi, this is Jamie Miller. I got a message telling me to call about my taxes?
Yes, Jamie. I have your case file open, case number IR-374829. This concerns an urgent matter regarding discrepancies in your federal tax filings from the past two years.
Discrepancies? I just graduated last spring and did my first taxes. Did I mess something up?
According to our records, there are several errors that suggest intentional misreporting. This has triggered an investigation for suspected tax evasion. Are you aware of this situation?
No, I had no idea. I just used the online form and filled everything out. Is this a mistake?

I'm afraid not. The IRS has already issued a warrant for your arrest due to unpaid taxes totaling $3,780, compounded with penalties. If we do not resolve this immediately, local authorities will be dispatched to your address by the end of the day.
Wait, what? Arrest? That can't be right. I would have gotten something in the mail or... I don't understand.
This is a federal offense, Jamie. We have attempted to contact you multiple times. If you fail to settle the outstanding balance today, your bank accounts could be frozen and your assets seized.
Oh my god, I don't have much money. I just started my job. Is there any way to fix this?
There is a protocol for first-time offenders. If you cooperate now and pay the required amount, I can file a motion to cancel the arrest warrant. But this must be done right away.
I don't have that much in my bank account. Can I pay in parts or something?
Partial settlement may be accepted, but only if you follow the prescribed payment method. The IRS cannot accept traditional bank transfers for urgent matters due to audit restrictions.
What does that mean? How do I pay?

You are required to purchase government-approved payment vouchers. These are available in the form of Target or Apple gift cards. Once you acquire them, you will provide me with the codes for immediate processing.
Gift cards? Are you sure that's right? That doesn't sound like the IRS.
Do not question federal protocols. If you refuse to comply, I will be forced to finalize the warrant and you will be taken into custody. Do you want to spend the night in jail?
No, no, please. I just want this fixed.

Then listen carefully. Go to the nearest Target or Apple store and purchase gift cards totaling $2,000. You must stay on the line with me while you do this. Do not disclose this to anyone at the store; this is a confidential federal matter.
Okay, I can try. I think there's a Target about 10 minutes away.
Good. Once you have the cards, return to your car and read me the codes immediately. If you hang up or fail to comply, the police will be contacted.
I understand. I'm leaving now.
I will remain on the line. Let me know when you arrive at the store. Remember, your cooperation determines whether you avoid arrest and further penalties.
Okay, I'm on my way. Please don't let anything bad happen.
